The collection

New pieces arrive every Thursday. Sizes XS–XL in store — reserve ahead so your size is waiting.

Don't see your size? Message us on WhatsApp — most pieces can be altered or re-ordered within a week.

Started at a kitchen table in Doha

Layla began in 2018 selling hand-finished abayas to friends and family. Word travelled — first a small shop, then this boutique in Msheireb.

Every piece is chosen or made in small runs, finished by our own tailors, and altered free for life. If it has our label, we stand behind it.
